여행.x: I'm going on a trip to Jeju Island during vacation.
여행.t: 'Go on a trip' = 여행(을) 가다. 여행사 = travel agency.

가깝다.x: The school is very close to my house.

웃기다.m: to be funny, to make (someone) laugh; to be ridiculous
웃기다.ex: 그 친구는 말을 정말 웃기게 해요.
웃기다.x: That friend says things in a really funny way.
웃기다.e: Causative of 웃다 'to laugh': literally 'to make someone laugh'.
웃기다.t: 웃기네! can sarcastically mean 'That's ridiculous!', so watch your tone.

배낭.x: On the weekend I put on a backpack and went to the mountains.
배낭.t: Use 메다 for backpacks: 배낭을 메다.

두껍다.x: It's cold outside, so wear thick clothes.
두껍다.t: For books, clothes and paper; for thick soup or color use 진하다, for thick fingers use 굵다.

얇다.ex: 날씨가 따뜻한 봄에는 얇은 옷을 입어요.
얇다.x: In spring, when it's warm, I wear thin clothes.
얇다.t: Pronounced [얄따]. For thin people say 날씬하다 or 마르다, not 얇다.

야옹.forms: 야옹 + 하고 울다 · pet name: 야옹이
야옹.ex: 고양이가 배가 고픈지 야옹 하고 울어요.
야옹.x: The cat is meowing, maybe because it's hungry.
야옹.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating a cat's cry.
야옹.t: 야옹이 'kitty' is a common pet name. Online, cat lovers say 냥이 for a cat (casual).

관객.ex: 공연이 끝나자 관객들이 모두 박수를 쳤어요.
관객.x: When the performance ended, the whole audience applauded.
관객.t: 관객 is for a live show or movie audience; TV viewers are 시청자 and readers are 독자.

활동.ex: 방학 동안 다양한 활동을 해 보고 싶어요.
활동.x: I want to try various activities during vacation.

규칙.x: You have to follow the rules carefully in the dorm.

지식.x: Reading a lot of books broadens your knowledge.

믿음.x: Between friends, trust is the most important thing.
믿음.e: From 믿다 (to believe) + -음, which turns a verb into a noun.

불행하다.x: Some people are unhappy even if they have a lot of money.

멸종.ex: 기후 변화 때문에 많은 동물이 멸종 위기에 놓였어요.
멸종.x: Because of climate change, many animals are in danger of extinction.
멸종.t: Pronounced [멸쫑]: in Sino-Korean words, ㅈ after ㄹ becomes tense.

예습.ex: 수업 전에 예습을 하면 이해가 더 잘 돼요.
예습.x: If you prepare before class, you understand better.
예습.e: Literally 'practice beforehand'; its opposite is 복습 'review'.

잇다.forms: 이어요 · 이었어요 · 이을 거예요 · 이으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
잇다.m: to connect, join; to carry on, succeed
잇다.ex: 이 다리는 섬과 육지를 잇고 있어요.
잇다.x: This bridge connects the island to the mainland.
잇다.t: The ㅅ drops before vowels: 잇다 → 이어요, and 가업을 잇다 means 'to take over the family business.'

카톡.x: I'll send you a message on KakaoTalk when I get home.
카톡.e: Short for 카카오톡 'KakaoTalk'; 톡 is from English 'talk'.
카톡.t: Casual. Almost everyone in Korea uses this messenger app, so 카톡 is used like 'text': 카톡해 'text me', 카톡 왔어요 'I got a message'.

화상 회의.x: Today I joined a video conference from home.
화상 회의.e: 화상 'video image' (literally 'picture image') + 회의 'meeting' (literally 'meet and discuss').
화상 회의.t: Don't confuse this 화상 (畫像, image) with its homonym 화상 (火傷) 'burn'. 회의 is usually pronounced [회이].

비중.ex: 전체 인구에서 노인이 차지하는 비중이 커지고 있어요.
비중.x: The share of elderly people in the total population is growing.
비중.e: Literally 'compared weight': how heavy one part is relative to the whole.
비중.t: Usually paired with 차지하다: 비중을 차지하다 'to account for a share'.
rel: to take up, to account for

간병.m: caring for a sick person, nursing care
간병.ex: 어머니가 아버지의 간병을 혼자 하고 계세요.
간병.x: My mother is taking care of my sick father by herself.
간병.t: 간호 is professional nursing; 간병 is hands-on daily care, often by family or a hired caregiver.

건축가.x: A famous architect designed this art museum.
건축가.e: -가 = professional or expert: 건축가, 작가, 화가.

어른스럽다.x: That child is mature for her age.

거듭.forms: 거듭 + verb (거듭 강조하다); 거듭되다 = to be repeated
거듭.m: repeatedly, again and again, over and over
거듭.x: He apologized over and over for his mistake.
거듭.e: Same root as 거듭되다 'to be repeated' and 거듭나다 'to be reborn'.

진작.ex: 이럴 줄 알았으면 진작 말할걸 그랬어요.
진작.x: If I'd known this would happen, I should have said something sooner.
진작.t: Typically expresses regret: 진작 ~ㄹ걸 'I should have ~ sooner'.

모방하다.m: to imitate, to copy, to mimic
모방하다.x: Children learn by imitating their parents' behavior.

검증.ex: 새로운 약은 안전성 검증을 거쳐야 판매할 수 있습니다.
검증.x: A new drug can be sold only after passing safety verification.

재정비하다.m: to reorganize, to overhaul, to regroup
재정비하다.ex: 회사는 조직을 재정비하고 새 출발을 했어요.
재정비하다.x: The company overhauled its organization and made a fresh start.
재정비하다.e: Literally 'put in order and prepare again'.
재정비하다.t: 전열을 재정비하다 = to regroup, literally 'to re-form the battle lines'.

받아들여지다.m: to be accepted, to be received
받아들여지다.x: My proposal was accepted at the meeting.
받아들여지다.e: Passive of 받아들이다, built from 받다 'receive' plus 들이다 'bring in'.

백지장도 맞들면 낫다.forms: 백지장도 맞들면 낫다고 하잖아요 · 백지장도 맞들면 낫죠
백지장도 맞들면 낫다.m: many hands make light work; any task is easier when shared
백지장도 맞들면 낫다.ex: 백지장도 맞들면 낫다고, 같이 하면 금방 끝날 거예요.
백지장도 맞들면 낫다.x: Many hands make light work; if we do it together, we'll be done in no time.
백지장도 맞들면 낫다.e: Literally 'even a blank sheet of paper is lighter when two people lift it.'
백지장도 맞들면 낫다.t: 맞들다 means two people lifting something together, one on each side.
nb: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다

과학계.ex: 그 발견은 과학계에 큰 충격을 주었습니다.
과학계.x: That discovery sent a huge shock through the scientific community.
과학계.e: -계 = world, circle of a field: 과학계, 학계, 연예계.

보육.ex: 맞벌이 부부를 위한 보육 시설이 더 필요해요.
보육.x: More childcare facilities are needed for dual-income couples.
보육.t: 보육 is the public or institutional side; 육아 is parents raising their own kids.

회복세.ex: 수출이 늘면서 경제가 회복세를 보이고 있습니다.
회복세.x: With exports rising, the economy is showing signs of recovery.
회복세.e: -세 = momentum or trend: 상승세, 하락세, 회복세 — a very common news pattern.
회복세.t: Pronounced [회복쎄]; usually with 보이다 or 이어가다 in news reports.

숏폼.ex: 자기 전에 숏폼을 보다 보면 시간 가는 줄 몰라요.
숏폼.x: When I watch short-form videos before bed, I lose track of time.
숏폼.t: Usually vertical videos of about a minute or less; also 숏폼 영상 or 숏폼 콘텐츠. Longer videos are 롱폼. The official spelling of 'short' is 쇼트, but 숏폼 is the usual form.

보호무역.ex: 보호무역이 강화되면서 수출 기업들의 걱정이 커지고 있어요.
보호무역.x: As protectionism intensifies, exporters are growing more worried.
보호무역.e: Literally 'protective trade': shielding domestic industry with tariffs and quotas.

한계비용.x: Digital products have a marginal cost close to zero.
한계비용.e: 한계 'limit, margin' + 비용 'cost' — the cost of producing one more unit.
한계비용.t: In economics 한계 means 'marginal'; in daily speech it means 'limit': 한계가 있다 'there's a limit.'

기초과학.ex: 정부는 기초과학 연구에 더 많이 투자해야 합니다.
기초과학.x: The government should invest more in basic science research.

전집.ex: 대학생 때 셰익스피어 전집을 다 읽었어요.
전집.x: I read the complete works of Shakespeare in college.

넷제로.ex: 우리 회사는 2040년까지 넷제로를 달성하는 것이 목표예요.
넷제로.x: Our company's goal is to reach net zero by 2040.
넷제로.t: News often uses the Sino-Korean term 탄소중립 instead; both mean the same goal.

차용하다.x: Korean borrowed many words from Chinese.
차용하다.e: Literally 'borrow and use' — loans of money, words, or styles.
차용하다.t: 차용증 is the written IOU you sign when borrowing money privately.

암묵지.ex: 숙련된 기술자의 암묵지는 글로 전하기 어렵습니다.
암묵지.x: A skilled technician's tacit knowledge is hard to pass on in writing.
암묵지.e: Literally 'hidden silent knowing'; opposite of 형식지 'explicit knowledge'.
